description: This file defines the IEventHubQueueCacheFactory interface, which declares a method for creating a message cache for an EventHub partition, including parameters for partition identification, a checkpointer, and a logger factory.

classes.name: IEventHubQueueCacheFactory
classes.description: Interface for creating a cache for EventHub partitions.

methods.name: CreateCache
methods.description: Creates an instance of IEventHubQueueCache for a specified partition, checkpointer, and logger factory.

parameters.name: partition
parameters.description: The identifier for the EventHub partition.

parameters.name: checkpointer
parameters.description: A checkpointer to manage stream queue checkpoints.
